title: Tiger Gorilla
tagline: Swing through the treetops as the stripiest gorilla in the jungle, grabbing parrots to feed the hungry babies back at the nest.
blurb: Swing through the treetops as the stripiest gorilla in the jungle, grabbing parrots to feed the hungry babies back at the nest. Chilli-powered boosts, a vanishing trick, nosy photographers, snappy crocs and camera drones stand between you and a family safe at last. Twelve wrap-round jungle levels in three zones, with 128K music.

review.verdict: A swinging good time, even if the colours go bananas now and then.

quote.text: Bright, cheerful jungle, a lovely title page and a soppy ending

credits.name: GAZ PICKERING, MANDY ROWE and CLIVE BURRAGE for INK & PAPER
